Target labor code provision covers employer obligations toward domestic workers regarding travel expenses. Structuring text into JSON requires mapping clause identifiers and sentence components accurately.

Initial clause mapping assigns employer obligations based on the article title, designating the employer as the primary subject. Conditional phrases regarding contract termination and worker relocation require careful segmentation to separate preconditions from core obligations. Re-evaluating the clause structure indicates that certain conditional markers modify the applicability of the travel expense provision rather than forming independent duties.

Analyzing the exception clause indicates that the temporal modifier "trước thời hạn" functions as a core component of the termination action rather than an external applicability condition. Applying the structural rules keeps this modifier within the primary segment instead of isolating it as a temporal constraint.
